flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Report/lists/ReportListRIP.tsx (result grid: notice no, notice date/time, car park code, vehicle no, amount payable), ocmsadminapi workflows/reports/system/rip/RipReportServiceImpl (record). No ownership-change or deregistered indicator in the RIP result; lta_deregistration_date is only in LtaReportServiceImpl (separate LTA report)
note: The story asks the ownership enquiry result to be displayed with the notice number, offence date/time, car park, vehicle number and amount payable, plus an indicator of an ownership change or a deregistered vehicle. The existing RIP screen shows those notice columns, but for the furnished hirer/driver list, not for an ownership enquiry result, and there is no ownership-change or deregistered indicator. The deregistered data (lta_deregistration_date) only shows in a separate LTA report. 'Car park' shows as ppCode, labelled 'Place of Offence'. DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. Ticket: OCMS-DF-2026-194 (Open) concerns the manual LTA VRLS report download
recommendation: Claim only a small part: the notice columns in the RIP grid can be reused; the ownership-change and deregistered indicators on the enquiry result do not exist

steps.step: The results are displayed on screen to the Special Notice Processing Officer
steps.detail: The result shows in the RIP screen grid (ReportListRIP.tsx:74-76; index.tsx:85-88), but its content is the furnished deceased hirer/driver list (PS-RP2), not an ownership enquiry result from DOS (a generic page, not the one the story names). Access through OCMS_REPORT_RIP in api-authorization.properties:123-124; server-side role restriction was not checked further.

steps.step: The results contain notice number, offence date and time, car park, vehicle number and amount payable
steps.detail: The RIP grid has Notice No. (ReportListRIP.tsx:198), Notice Date & Time (:179), Place of Offence = ppCode (:186), Vehicle No. (:204) and Amount Payable (:210); the data is filled in RipReportServiceImpl.java:482-487. The columns exist but for the furnished RIP report, not for an ownership enquiry result; the car park is only a ppCode, not a name (whether the UI maps a name cannot be verified from the repo).

steps.step: The results indicate if there is a change in vehicle ownership
steps.detail: The RIP record and grid columns (RipReportServiceImpl.java:441-499; ReportListRIP.tsx:172-237) have no ownership-change indicator; there is no old/new owner column. See OCMS14.13 step 3.

steps.step: The results indicate if the vehicle has been deregistered
steps.detail: The RIP grid and record have no deregistered field (ReportListRIP.tsx:172-237). lta_deregistration_date is only stored by the LTA enquiry (LtaProcessingOrchestrator.java:327-338) and shown in a separate LTA report (LtaReportServiceImpl.java:205-206), not in the RIP result. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-194 (Open) concerns the manual LTA report download.
